title: Standard Curve Creation
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input the desired parameters in the OT App, specifying up to 8 different stocks and generating an 11‑point standard curve for each in blood media.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol files
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if it is compressed before proceeding.

steps.title: Upload custom labware to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the required labware files with .json extensions to upload.

steps.title: Upload protocol file to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Protocol tab of the OT App, upload the protocol file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck layout exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware, tiprack, and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the OT App calibration routine to calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette; consult the support articles for calibration tips if needed.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the Run button in the OT App to start the standard‑curve preparation.
